profile.headline: Software Engineer at Zen Payments
profile.summary: As a software engineer, I take immense pride in the work I produce. I approach every project with enthusiasm and a commitment to deliver high-quality solutions that exceed expectations. I thrive in environments where I can apply my analytical mindset to create innovative solutions. I am constantly looking for places where I can learn and improve in order to become the best at what I do.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer, I work alongside a team of 2-3 Developers to develop the key infrastructure for our company front to back.
●  Primary Frontend Engineer for 4 secured web apps, 2 customer facing and 2 internal tooling. 
●  Assisted closely in development of UI / UX of custom web apps and external tools. 
●  Helped build backend automations within AWS, Azure and Zapier to sit on top of our CRM to streamline workflow.
●  Coordinated and lead out the adoption of an Agile workflow to increase development efficiency.

Tech Stack: MySQL, Node, React / Next.js, Raw CSS / Tailwind, Sanity CMS, Jest & Cypress Testing Frameworks

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description: Worked within a large team to develop fast, efficient web applications and manipulate large amounts of data. Primarily worked in React with developer tools such as Jira, Version1 and Splunk.

positions.title: Apprentice Technician
positions.description: Worked within a fast paced environment leading a team of 3-5 technicians to perform services for customer’s vehicles in an effective and most efficient manner and problem solve any issues encountered.
